dataItem-m5ugfcfr.text: SCAD X HARBOR - Week 1

dataItem-m5ugj60g.text: After discussing with my teammates, we chose a watch as the product. The story follows the journey of a luxury watch as it undergoes an intricate transformation—from raw, unrefined elements to a masterfully crafted timepiece that emerges into the world as a symbol of elegance and precision.

dataItem-m5uh05cm.text: This week, we decided on the name of our team: Cronos. We also chose our product: a watch. The pre-production phase includes a storyboard, mood board, previs, and references for each shot.
